**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Founded 1927, published under the Société psychanalytique de Paris (SPP), an IPA-affiliated society; flagship French-language psychoanalysis journal. 5 issues/year (4 quarterly + 1 congress special issue), each with a themed section (1/3-1/2 of an issue's original articles) built from a published 'argument', plus a dossier on a current clinical/societal issue, miscellaneous articles, and book/journal reviews. Current 2027-2028 CFP themes (checked 2026-07-13): 'De l'avenir d'une illusion' (deadline 2026-07-01), 'Transferts' (2026-09-01), 'Temps mêlés, temps démêlés' (2026-11-15), 'L'agir revisité' (2027-01-15), 'Mauvais parents' (2027-07-01).

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** clinical case discussion (psychoanalytic), metapsychological/theoretical essay, close reading of classical Freudian and post-Freudian texts, critical review of books/journals/cultural works
